scan.pinterest_status: Pinterest's official Business blog, 19 October BFCM conversion-ramp guidance, current creator trend report, 2026 Palette guidance and a relevant public design-inspiration Pin were checked on 21 October 2026. The BFCM report reinforces phased creative as intent sharpens: discovery and saves first, more product-led assets next, then clear value, availability and purchase paths at peak. Current creator trends are topical executions rather than durable command gaps. The public Pinterest Pin returned HTTP 403 when opened, so no visual inference was made from inaccessible content.
scan.chatgpt_status: Production v2.25.0 with 720 commands was read before evaluation. /intent-to-action already assigns asset jobs across discovery, confidence, decision and action; /performance-creative-mix already maps genuine format variety and testing; /catalog-creative-system already protects product, price, availability and destination parity; /taste-discovery-system and /emotional-palette already cover aesthetic and colour exploration. No materially new, non-duplicate command was warranted. The userscript remained byte-identical, and all 18 regression checks passed.
trends: BFCM creative should begin before the promotion window because shoppers save, compare and shortlist products early
Creative roles should shift with intent: contextual inspiration and curation first, increasingly product-led value and low-friction action closer to purchase
Price, availability and purchase-path clarity must remain visible through peak shopping and into the comparison period after Cyber Monday
Current creator trends include Bedazzled Everything, 90s hair accessories, Fawn Season and home-café engineering
The 2026 Palette continues to favour emotionally useful colour systems and colour-led discovery rather than colour as decoration alone
skipped: No BFCM conversion-ramp command because /intent-to-action, /performance-creative-mix and /catalog-creative-system already cover phased asset roles, format shifts, product truth and action paths across the same journey
No holiday-urgency command because the durable behavior is intent staging, while calendar-specific copy and offers belong in the brief

No Bedazzled Everything, Fawn Season, 90s hair-accessory or home-café command because these are topical motifs that existing tactile, beauty, retro, lifestyle and trend-to-brand controls can translate safely
No individual 2026 Palette colour commands because /emotional-palette and /taste-discovery-system already support exact colour roles, combinations, emotional utility and brand adaptation
No visual command was derived from the public Pinterest Pin that returned HTTP 403
